subject: MSA + Order Form: security exhibit redlines and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Terry Nolan <terry.nolan@bluestonehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA security exhibit — initial asks and evidence cadence

Connor / Laura,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our legal team, attached is a short list of changes BlueStone needs in the MSA security exhibit and the Order Form to proceed: a) clearer pen-test notice timing and staging access, b) SOC 2 artifact mapping for key assertions, and c) a proposed quarterly evidence cadence plus a separate pen-test window cadence.

Key asks (high level):
- Pen test: 30-day advance notice + two 48-hour staging windows per year; ability to observe test execution via Zoom; requirement that Redwood provide a post-test mitigation summary within 10 business days.
- SOC 2: evidence export for selected controls (list in attachment) with a monthly snapshot export for 6 months after onboarding.
- Redlines: we've annotated the exhibit with liability and data access carveouts for PII-handling subsystems.

We can be flexible on timing if we can agree on the evidence handoff workflow and a mutual action plan for legal redlines. Attaching our asks: BlueStone_Security_Exhibit_asks.docx (doc stub).

Can you confirm who from Redwood legal will own the redline and a target date for a first-pass response? We have a commercial timeline the week of April 4th.

Best,

Terry Nolan
Head of Security & Compliance
BlueStone Health
T: 415-555-0127

Attachment: BlueStone_Security_Exhibit_asks.docx (docx, 42 KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Terry Nolan <terry.nolan@bluestonehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA security exhibit — initial asks and evidence cadence

Thanks Terry — appreciate the clear list and the attachment.

Short answers before I loop legal in: we are comfortable with finite staging windows for pen tests and providing a post-test summary. A few clarifying points we'd like to confirm so legal can draft a clean redline:
1) Notice window: we usually accept 30 days for full-scope pen tests but can also accommodate a shorter 14-day notice for smaller scoped tests if agreed up front.
2) Observation: we can provide a remote observation channel but cannot give live credentials or debug-level access; we will provide sanitized telemetry and a readout of findings.
3) Evidence exports: we can deliver scoped SOC 2 artifacts for the mapped controls; for production reasons we surface aggregated exports monthly for 3 months after onboarding, longer retention can be via a separate engagement (we can discuss).

I'm looping in Karthik from legal to propose specific MSA language and a redline set. Laura — can you help with the ops-side acceptance criteria for the pen test windows (who owns the runbook/point-of-contact)?

I'll aim to get a Redwood first-pass redline to you by Wednesday EOD (Mar 24) so your team has time ahead of your April 4 timeline. Attaching a short summary for your ops team: redwood_response_summary.pdf (pdf stub).

Connor O'Brien
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Phone: 650-555-0193

Attachment: redwood_response_summary.pdf (pdf, 18 KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Terry Nolan <terry.nolan@bluestonehealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA security exhibit — initial asks and evidence cadence

Terry / Connor / Laura,

Thanks for the context — I reviewed BlueStone's asks and put together a proposed redline that balances BlueStone's needs with Redwood's security and operational constraints. I've attached the draft MSA exhibit redline (MSA_redline_20270322.docx). High-level items included below so we're aligned before an external send: 

1) Pen Test / Inspection Rights
- Redwood accepts up to two (2) staging inspection windows per 12-month period for security testing, each window limited to 48 consecutive hours.
- Customer to provide no less than thirty (30) days' notice for full-scope tests. For scoped vulnerability scans, parties may agree to a 14-day notice by mutual email.
- Redwood will provide temporary, scoped telemetry access and an observation session (screen share). Redwood will not permit live interactive credentials or break-glass access to internal debugging consoles.
- Redwood will provide a consolidated remediation/mitigation summary within ten (10) business days of test completion; critical remediation timelines will be tracked in a joint action item list.

2) SOC 2 Artifacts & Evidence Cadence
- For SOC 2 assertions listed in Appendix A, Redwood will provide monthly evidence snapshots for an initial period of three (3) months post-onboarding. Customers may request extended retention (6 or 12 months) via a paid evidence retention add-on.
- Evidence provided will be limited to control evidence exports (logs, configuration exports, attestation documents). Production data extracts are out of scope; any export requiring PII access will be delivered as pseudonymized extracts where feasible.

3) Confidentiality / Liability Carveouts
- Redwood proposes language to limit inspection to information reasonably necessary to validate controls and excludes forensic-level access to customer data stores.
- Any forensic or live-debugging engagements requiring elevated access will be subject to a separate SOW.

4) Operational Runbook
- Laura, suggest we include an ops runbook snippet in the exhibit describing the staging access steps, contact list (SOC/ops on-call), and escalation path (incident -> triage -> remediation).

If that approach is acceptable I'd like to circulating a tracked-redline to BlueStone by EOD today (Wed Mar 24) so they have time to review ahead of the April 4 commercial milestone.

Attachment: MSA_redline_20270322.docx (docx, 36 KB)

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Karthik / Connor,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the concrete redlines. The changes look reasonable overall — two quick clarifications from our side before we lock: 
1) The SOC 2 evidence: can you confirm the export format (CSV, PDF bundle) and whether the monthly snapshots will include configuration snapshots for infra controls (we tagged items in Appendix A).
2) Pen test observation: BlueStone requests that the observation session accommodate up to three BlueStone engineers in addition to the lead — is that acceptable?

If both are OK we'll circulate an internal redline and get back to you by EOD Monday (Mar 29). Meanwhile I'll attach the current order form draft for commercial to start review (DocuSign_OrderForm_DRAFT.pdf).

Also — please add the HubSpot deal link and a shared drive for evidence uploads when you circulate the tracked changes. That will help the compliance team follow the timeline.

Thanks,
Terry Nolan
Head of Security & Compliance
BlueStone Health
